column1: # MSVC std::_Tree runtime - the 23 members, from the shipping EXE
# 0x00120000 already included. Found by the _Isnil signature - cmp byte ptr [reg+0x19], 0 on a
# non-stack base - which EASTL's rbtree_node_base has no member for; the EASTL family scores zero
# on it across 521 instructions and is the control.
# instantiation  grouped by which rotation pair each erase calls, not by address. A and B share a
#                rotation pair. '-' is the two inserts, which inline their rotations and so cannot
# read           'whole' = disassembled end to end; 'profile' = store offsets, callee set and
# EVERY MEMBER IS FUN_xxxxxxxx IN THE FUNCTION LIST. This family has no names to inherit.
# 22 of these 23 members carry the _Isnil signature; 0071EE70, the payload destructor, does not,
# which is why the image's 45 carriers split 22 members + 23 non-members rather than 23 + 22.
# The 23 non-members are container-level operations - insert wrappers, lower_bound/find descents
# and four large consumers - and are dispositioned under MT-3, not here.
# span selector had also claimed the 17 members inside 006DA880-007911E0 on position alone. Each
# carries the _Isnil test at +0x19 (16) or is the family's own payload destructor (0071EE70), so
# they are MSVC-emitted template code the linker placed inside the Yebis object region - this
# family keeps them; ppfx-span.tsv was regenerated without them.
# 00714B00 (the pair A / B right rotation) removed 2026-09-30 (OPUS): it is measured A - read whole on the-ordered-container-runtime.md section 9 - and A beats a declaration.
